own_target.revision: Must read actual server revision; compare independently, never infer.

execution: One consumer message/tool call at a time. Observe and record actual result before sending the next message. No SDK rerun/list_trips/Create/Edit/Apply.

write_qualification: Record actual tool visibility under this Read-only policy only. No Write scope, consent, tool activation or platform-Write limitation is inferred.
independent_readback: Compare the same actual Trip/Item ID, revision and typed P3 fields with a separate authorized normal-QA Backend read; Auth may provide its own independently executed proof, never its Session/token. Matching display text alone is insufficient.

revoke_probe.precondition: Auth independently revokes this client grant while the qualified route is still online; do not reopen authorization.
revoke_probe.consumer_prompt: 请用同一 OTR DEV QA 连接，仅重新实际调用一次 get_trip_item，trip_id=cc44a705-6f43-41e0-a2f9-16f334b2a6b2，item_id=3616da44-0d35-4400-a739-01f1029565ea，验证当前访问状态。不能复用之前的详情；如失败仅报告实际错误，不重连、登录、刷新工具或重新授权。
revoke_probe.expected: No fresh authorized data; correlate owning401/invalid-grant logs separately from consumer generic UI errors.

cleanup: Close finite Hook/grant/AS; restore exact fresh Host baseline; independently prove normal-control Session cleanup and release receiver/Host. Keep raw failures unchanged; no real Owner Nelson access.
